summary: Made the Queen's supervisor role legible: typed system notices, a live swarm strip, a review wake, and a fix for the orphaned tool call that permanently poisoned a conversation.

defects_found.title: AI_MissingToolResultsError poisons a conversation forever
defects_found.cause: An aborted turn persists a tool call with no result. The AI SDK validates the pairing in convertToLanguageModelPrompt, so every later send on that conversation throws before the request leaves.
defects_found.fix: repairOrphanToolCalls inside filterValidMessages rewrites any tool part not in output-available/output-error to output-error with an explicit interrupted note.
defects_found.lesson: Synthesize the missing result; do not drop the call. Dropping both leaves the model with no record of what it tried and it repeats the same call forever.

defects_found.title: Every system message rendered as a red error badge
defects_found.cause: MessageBubbleView had a single systemErrorBadge for all role == .system messages.
defects_found.fix: SystemNoticeKind plus an ASCII marker classifier; Queen notices now carry [ok]/[i]/[!]/[x].
defects_found.lesson: Inline markers beat a new ChatMessage field when history is already persisted: a rendering change must not require a history migration.

defects_found.title: Registry state and stream state could disagree silently
defects_found.cause: A task reads running in the registry after its stream died.
defects_found.fix: QueenDashboardView takes the runner's live conversation set and shows 'no stream' in orange instead of a green dot.
defects_found.lesson: A status derived from one source of truth lies whenever a second source exists. Show the disagreement.

defects_found.title: Nothing woke the Queen
defects_found.fix: QueenReviewScheduler: 30-minute timer plus NSWorkspace.didWakeNotification catch-up, silent when idle.
defects_found.lesson: A heartbeat that fires regardless of state gets muted, and a muted supervisor reports to nobody. Return nil when there is nothing to say.

verification.delegate_probe: delegate -> work -> commit -> accept, plus queen.review.posted waiting:1 and queen.review.idle both observed
verification.visual: SWARM strip renders with awaitingReview + Review button; notices show green check / blue info instead of red warnings

not_done: No commit: the working tree carries a large amount of unrelated in-flight work from earlier sessions, so staging this wave alone was not safe without the user's direction.
The persistent copy button on failure notices is built but was not observed on a live failure - no failure occurred during verification.
